test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about Raja Ram Mohan Roy?

options.text: He wrote a book 'A gift to monotheists'.
He is considered as the pioneer of modern Indian Renaissance.
He believed in social equality of all human beings.

solution:
The correct answer is __**He founded Arya Samaj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy**

 
 
• An Indian social and religious reformer named **Ram Mohan Roy was one of the founders of the Brahmo Sabha in 1828**, which served as the forerunner to the **Brahmo Samaj**.
 
• The **Mughal emperor Akbar II** conferred the title of Raja on him.
 
• **Politics, government, education, and religion** were all areas where he had a noticeable impact.
 
• He was well-known for his work to end **child marriage and sati**.
 
• For many historians, Roy is regarded as the** "Father of the Bengal Renaissance" and also the "pioneer of modern Indian Renaissance."**
 
• He always believed in **social equality** for all human beings.
 
• He also wrote a famous book **'A gift to monotheists'**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Roy was listed as the **10th greatest Bengali **of all time by the **BBC in 2004**. 
 
• He founded the** Atmiya Sabha and the Unitarian Community** to combat social injustices and promote social and educational change in India.
 
• He was the one who fought against strange ideas, a** pioneer in Indian education, and a forerunner in Bengali literature and Indian journalism**.
 
• Ram Mohan Roy worked for the **East India Company **during the early years of its rule and engaged in political agitation.
 
• On **April 7, 1875, sannyasi Dayanand Saraswati**, established the Arya Samaj.
 
• **Proselytization in Hinduism **was first introduced by Arya Samaj.
